fieldValues.title: The decisions under a decision are hard to see, and are not tested later
fieldValues.statement: Decisions taken one at a time hide their foundations; the threads beneath one only show with time and in context. Nothing brings a decision and its consequences back for review in context, so incoherence between decisions is found late, if at all. Judging a decision now and testing its coherence later are different acts, and the second has no place in how a group works.
